title: Esc menu
note: The menu over the running game (no pause): Esc (ui_cancel) opens and closes it; the game runs on, the mouse is free while it is open and captured again on close. While it is open the own character takes no gameplay input (it stands still: no move, look, sprint, jump, interact or item use; those keys go to the menu or nowhere); the voice keeps working as set (voice activation, or the Talk key while held). The page shows one frame per tab and case; the focused control is drawn in every state that has one. MVP (m8, 2026-10-20): the roles are alien and human; the Lobby tab has the MVP host settings; the Guide lists the MVP's five tasks. Open (the engineer's design, each a visible placeholder here): the humans' default per player count and what each preset sets; the anger threshold's choices; Knives and the No knives preset (weapons are deferred); the MVP tasks' other settings (only the Wi-Fi's N is decided); the Guide's new topics (points, mutations, the neighbours' anger, the cops, the dead's room); every MVP task's card art (the art track's; own-work Delivery frames stand in here). The game boots straight into the ship (the engineer, 2026-10-21; s2 was removed), and the suit menu holds the start screen's old jobs on its Game tab while there is no session (host, join with a code, join by address, the tutorial) and Settings everywhere.

states.label: Корабель
states.note: In the ship with no session: the game boots straight here (the engineer, 2026-10-21) and every player returns here when a session ends or they leave it. The menu opens on Game, named Find a lobby (esc.tab.find) while there is no session, whose page holds the jobs of the removed start screen (s2): host, join with a code, join by address, the tutorial. No Lobby or Role tab without a session; Character applies live. Focus on Resume.

states.label: Корабель: код
states.note: Join pressed: the code field opens beside the list, focused; six valid characters typed, so Join is enabled (it stays disabled until then).

states.label: Корабель: за адресою
states.note: Join by address pressed: the address field, focused, with the default port under it; Join, or host directly.

states.label: Лобі: хост
states.note: In the lobby, the host's view (the Esc menu opens on Lobby there): presets, the MVP match settings the host edits live (the humans, the anger threshold, the match length, the Wi-Fi passwords; frame 7 of pages/mvp-screens), the room code with Copy, a full lobby of 10 players (the list scrolls) and Ready. Role is hidden in the lobby.

states.label: Лобі: гравець
states.note: A player's view of the same tab, and everyone's in a round (settings change only in the lobby): values without steppers, tasks as static chips, the host's name by a lock. This player joined with the code, so the code row shows.

states.label: Лобі: без коду
states.note: The host's view when the code service closed or was never reachable: one line in place of the code row.

states.label: Персонаж
states.note: In the lobby: the name and the body colour apply live.

states.label: Персонаж у раунді
states.note: In a round: locked; the name is read-only and the swatches take no input.

states.label: Гра: хост
states.note: In a round (the menu opens on Game there), the host: Leave and Quit open the confirm dialog.

states.label: Гра: гравець
states.note: In a round, a player: Leave and Quit act at once.

states.label: Гра: підтвердження
states.note: The host pressed Leave: the confirm dialog (P1) over the menu. Quit opens the same dialog titled esc.game.quit_confirm with Confirm esc.game.quit.

states.label: Роль: прибулець
states.note: In a round only: the own role and its goal.

states.label: Роль: людина
states.note: A human also sees the other humans (humans know each other: the engineer, 2026-10-20; one here, Zinga, as in s6 and s7); the list scrolls when it is longer than the view. With no other human the Team column is hidden.

states.label: Посібник
states.note: Every how-to card: the basics from the tutorial and one card per MVP task type; Cooking selected. Its art is a placeholder (own-work Delivery frames) until the art track's cards exist; the card holds as many frames as its task needs and scrolls sideways.

states.label: Звук і голос
states.note: Settings opens on Sound and voice. Voice activation is selected, so the threshold row shows. Settings shows only here since the game boots into the ship.

states.label: Керування
states.note: Interact is capturing a key; Talk was rebound to M, so Talk and Map show Same key. The list scrolls.

states.label: Екран
states.note: The window mode.

states.label: Доступність
states.note: Large text and reduced motion.

states.label: Мова
states.note: The game language; it applies at once.

states.label: Навчання
states.note: The tutorial's menu: only Game, Guide and Settings; Leave goes back to the ship.

nodes.name: Dim
nodes.note: Dims the running game behind the menu.

children.name: Tabs
children.note: One ButtonGroup; the selected tab shows its page. 288 px holds the longest tab, «Налаштування», at large text, so the page never shifts between text sizes. Default tab: Game in the ship with no session, Lobby in the lobby, Game in a round and in the tutorial; the last tab is kept for the session. Role is hidden in the lobby; the tutorial shows only Game, Guide and Settings. Focus starts on the selected tab (drawn selected-focus); on Game, Resume takes it.

children.name: Game
children.note: One tab, two names: esc.tab.find («Знайти лобі», the engineer's word, 2026-10-22) while there is no session, esc.tab.game in a session; the game swaps the key when a session starts or ends.

children.name: Settings
children.note: settings-controls: focus is on the capturing Interact key, so this tab is drawn selected without focus.

children.name: Title
children.note: The selected tab's name.

children.name: HostOnly
children.note: A player's view in the lobby only; hidden in a round, where nobody changes the settings and the values without steppers already read as fixed.

children.name: Locked
children.note: In a round the Character tab is locked: the same lock line as the guest's HostOnly, in the title row, so the page below does not move.

children.name: Presets
children.note: One ButtonGroup over the cards (Save is not in it). A card applies its values; any other change deselects every card (a player then reads preset.custom). Save your own stores one custom preset: a card named preset.custom, built like Standard, appears before Save. The four cards share the page width (expand_fill, at least 196 px: «Звичайний» at large text), as on the MVP sketch. What Standard and Quick set for the humans and the anger threshold is open (the engineer's design); whether No knives stays is open (weapons are deferred, m8 §7).

children.name: Standard
children.note: The card has no text of its own: V holds the preset's name and its note (the preset's match duration); the note is ToyPresetCardNote on an idle card and ToyPresetCardNoteSelected on the selected one.

children.name: NoKnives
children.note: Open (weapons are deferred, m8 §7): kept as a placeholder until the engineer decides which melee the MVP keeps.

children.name: Save
children.note: A press button with the card's face (not a toggle, not in the ButtonGroup): saves the current values as the own preset. Its name wraps onto two lines where it is longer than the card.

children.name: Preset
children.note: {preset} is tr() of the applied preset's name key (preset.standard, preset.quick, preset.no_knives), or preset.custom.

children.name: SettingList
children.note: The host's edits apply live for everyone. The rows of frame 7 of pages/mvp-screens: the humans, the anger threshold, the match length, the Wi-Fi passwords, after the lobby name; Packages and the task rows (Delivery, Switches) are gone with Delivery. Every row is at least 96 px tall (the field row's height), so the rows of a list keep one height; every control sits in a 345 px column at the right (the sketch's 230 x 1.5). Open (the engineer's design): the humans' default per player count, the anger threshold's choices, what else each MVP task sets (only the Wi-Fi's N is decided), and Knives (weapons are deferred).

children.name: Field
children.note: The lobby name (#214), lobby.default_name until the host changes it; auto_translate_mode DISABLED. editable false for a player (the quiet read-only box), who cannot scroll it: 345 px (the control column of the MVP sketch) holds about 16 characters at large text; a longer name shows its start. max_length per #214, which has not set it yet.

children.name: Humans
children.note: The exact number of humans among the players (m8 §2, #1032), as lobby.setting.humans_of: {count} of {total}, where {total} is the players now in the lobby (the stepper's maximum). Bounds and the default per player count are open (research round 2 suggests 4→1 … 10→3).

children.name: Value
children.note: {count} the humans set; {total} the players now in the lobby, which is also the stepper's maximum, so it follows joins and leaves: 3 of 10 in the full lobby, 1 of 4 in the guest's lobby of 4.

children.name: Anger
children.note: The neighbours' anger threshold that calls the cops (m8 §5). Its choices are open (the engineer's design); 50 and 100 are the sketch's samples.

children.name: Choice
children.note: One ButtonGroup, one toggle chip per threshold; each label is the number (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Value
children.note: A player sees the chosen threshold only: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), under the steppers' values.

children.name: Less
children.note: Steps the value down; disabled (unplugged) at the lower bound. Keyboard and gamepad reach Less and More by focus (ui_left and ui_right move between them) and step with ui_accept. When a step reaches a bound, the other arrow takes focus (More.grab_focus()) before this one is disabled, so focus never rests on an unplugged arrow. The value is 156 px wide, so every stepper has one width and the arrows line up down the list. Every stepper below works the same; a player sees only the value.

children.name: More
children.note: Steps the value up; disabled (unplugged) at the upper bound.

children.name: WifiPasswords
children.note: The Wi-Fi task's N: the passwords to enter before the task is done (GDD §8, a decided lobby setting). Bounds and the default are the game's data.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Knives
children.note: Open (weapons are deferred, m8 §7): a placeholder until the engineer decides which melee the MVP keeps.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: CodeRow
children.note: The room code, to whoever knows it: the host who hosted with a code and each player who joined with it (never an address), drawn as a keycap as on the lobby HUD (s4, the same row). Hidden for a Direct host and for Direct joiners (no code exists).

children.name: Text
children.note: The room code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED).

children.name: Copy
children.note: DisplayServer.clipboard_set(code); the text reads esc.lobby.copied for 1.5 s, then esc.lobby.copy again.

children.name: CodeGone
children.note: In place of CodeRow, only for a host who hosted with a code, when the code service closed or was never reachable; a Direct host sees neither.

children.name: Scroll
children.note: Takes the height left between the code row and Ready inside the fixed menu, so a full lobby of 10 never makes the menu taller: the rows scroll (lobby-host shows 10 players, lobby-guest 4). follow_focus = true.

children.name: Name
children.note: One row per player in join order: the own row reads player.you, the host's row lobby.host_mark with the host's name, the others the name alone (auto_translate_mode DISABLED). In the host's own view the first row is the own one. A long name is cut with an ellipsis, so it never widens the menu.

children.name: Ready
children.note: Shown while the player is ready; not ready leaves the slot empty (no dash). The marks are hidden in a round.

children.name: Ready
children.note: Toggles the own ready state: while ready it is pressed (ToyButtonPrimary's pressed look) and shows the check icon (check.svg at 24 px, tinted by ToyButtonPrimary's icon colours) before its text, the same as the own row's mark (lobby-guest: this player is ready; the page does not draw the pressed look with its icon yet). Hidden in a round, where nobody gets ready.

children.name: Preview
children.note: In the game: SubViewportContainer (stretch true) · min 456×608 with a SubViewport showing the own character; the page draws a ToyHowtoFrame placeholder.

children.name: Form
children.note: Changes apply live in the lobby. The Hat row (esc.character.hat) stays hidden until hats exist.

children.name: Field
children.note: The player's name, kept between sessions; auto_translate_mode DISABLED. editable false in a round.

children.name: Swatches
children.note: The ten body colours (#255; the palette is not decided yet).

children.name: Swatch1
children.note: In the game: TextureButton · toggle_mode · one ButtonGroup · 60×60 (focus_mode ALL in the lobby, NONE in a round; mouse_filter IGNORE in a round). The disc is tinted with the body colour (content data, #255; the page's colours are samples only).

children.name: Disc
children.note: self_modulate = the body colour (content data).

children.name: Ring
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE.

children.name: Sel
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE; visible while the swatch is selected.

children.name: Focus
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE; visible while the swatch has keyboard or gamepad focus (drawn here on the third swatch).

children.name: Resume
children.note: Closes the menu (as Esc). Takes focus when the menu opens on Game.

children.name: Leave
children.note: The host: the danger colour (ToyButtonDanger), opens the confirm dialog. A player: ToyButtonSecondary, leaves at once. In the tutorial: ToyButtonSecondary esc.game.leave_tutorial, back to the ship. Leaving a session returns the player to the ship (s5 ship).

children.name: Quit
children.note: The host: opens the confirm dialog (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). A player, and in the tutorial: quits at once.

children.name: Ship
children.note: The Game page in the ship with no session, its tab named esc.tab.find (the jobs of the removed start screen s2, #111; prime-game#1285): the list at the left, the open join field at its right. There is no server browser: Host makes a game with a code, Join takes a code, Join by address joins or hosts directly (LAN, VPN). Join and Join by address are one ButtonGroup with allow_unpress: pressing one opens its field, pressing it again, Back or Esc (ui_cancel) closes it (Esc with no field open closes the menu). The target page's «Знайти лобі» list (lobbies nearby) is not drawn: it has no copy key and the game has no server browser (docs/ui-decisions.md).

children.name: Items
children.note: Up and down move the focus through the list. 420 px holds «Приєднатися за адресою» at large text.

children.name: Resume
children.note: Closes the menu (as Esc). Takes focus when the menu opens.

children.name: Host
children.note: Hosts a game with a code (WebRTC): the ship becomes the lobby (s4) and the menu, opened again, shows the Lobby tab with the code; a failure shows s3 host-failed.

children.name: Join
children.note: In the join ButtonGroup; button_pressed while CodePanel is open (the pressed StyleBox). Toggles CodePanel.

children.name: Direct
children.note: In the join ButtonGroup; button_pressed while DirectPanel is open. Toggles DirectPanel.

children.name: Tutorial
children.note: Loads the tutorial's first lesson (s1); its end returns to the ship.

children.name: Quit
children.note: Quits the game at once (no session to end).

children.name: CodePanel
children.note: Join with a code; no panel of its own inside the menu's tile (agent).

children.name: Code
children.note: Focused when the field opens, empty until typed. max_length 6; upper-cases as typed, drops spaces and dashes on paste, accepts only the 31-letter code alphabet (no 0, O, 1, I, L). Keeps what was typed after a failure (back from s3). Enter = Join when it is enabled. auto_translate_mode DISABLED.

children.name: Join
children.note: Disabled (unplugged) until the field holds 6 valid characters. Joins by the code: s3 finding.

children.name: Back
children.note: Closes the field and unpresses Join; Esc does the same.

children.name: DirectPanel
children.note: Join or host directly over ENet (LAN, VPN, playit.gg). No address is shown anywhere else (streams).

children.name: Address
children.note: Focused when the field opens. Takes host or host:port, host names included (JoinTarget). Keeps what was typed after a failure. Enter = Join. auto_translate_mode DISABLED.

children.name: Port
children.note: The default port, used when the address has none.

children.name: Join
children.note: Disabled (unplugged) while Address is empty. Joins over ENet: s3 (the connecting steps, no code row).

children.name: Host
children.note: Hosts directly (ENet) on the port typed, else the default; the ship becomes the lobby (s4) with no code row.

children.name: Back
children.note: Closes the field and unpresses Join by address; Esc does the same.

children.name: Role
children.note: Reads only the own role and, for a human, the other humans.

children.name: Role
children.note: The own side at the display size: ToyDisplayOnLight (the accent) with role.alien, ToyDisplayAlertOnLight (the danger colour) with role.human, as in s6 and s7.

children.name: Team
children.note: Humans only (humans know each other: the engineer, 2026-10-20); hidden when there is no other human. Aliens see no list.

children.name: Count
children.note: The number of the other humans (here one, Zinga, as in s6 and s7).

children.name: Scroll
children.note: The view is 375 px tall; the list scrolls when it is longer.

children.name: Grid
children.note: Two columns, in join order; a long list scrolls in the 375 px view.

children.name: Name
children.note: The other human's name (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); a long name is cut with an ellipsis.

children.name: List
children.note: Fills the page height. follow_focus = true, so keyboard and gamepad focus scrolls the chip in view. 360 px holds the longest chip at large text.

children.name: V
children.note: One ButtonGroup over every chip; a chip shows its card, titled with the chip's text. The MVP's new topics (points, mutations, the neighbours' anger, the cops, the dead's room) are open: their texts and cards are the engineer's.

children.name: Moving
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.move.title, .pick_up.title, .put_down.title, .hand_belt.title.

children.name: Voice
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.voice.title, tutorial.step.voice.how, tutorial.list.death.

children.name: Downed
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.downed.title, downed.give_up_hold, then the death frames: tutorial.step.dead_room.title, tutorial.step.dead_room.how (drafts; the dead wait in the dead's room, m8 §3).

children.name: Gap
children.note: A spacer: 12 + 12 + 12 = 36 px between the Downed chip and the Tasks caption.

children.name: CarTuning
children.note: The MVP's five task types (GDD §8, #1144), in the deck's order. Each card needs new wordless art (the card art quality bar); until the art track's cards exist every card shows the placeholder (own-work Delivery frames, dist/pack/cards/).

children.name: Card
children.note: P8 how-to card; a card is content data per task type (#254). Its frames stand in one row that scrolls sideways (Scroll), as in s3 and s8, with 272 px art beside the topic list.

children.name: Scroll
children.note: The frames scroll sideways when they do not fit (the engineer, 2026-10-22): a card holds as many frames as its task needs. No bar is drawn (SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_NEVER) until the pack has a sideways bar; the frame cut at the card's edge shows there is more. The wheel scrolls it sideways while vertical scrolling is disabled, a drag on a touch screen too (unconfirmed for Godot 4.7.2: check ScrollContainer's wheel handling); follow_focus true. Here the view fills the card beside the topic list (at least one frame, 302 px).

children.name: Art
children.note: PLACEHOLDER art: seven own-work Delivery frames (dist/pack/cards/delivery-meaning-1..3, delivery-1..3 and delivery-meaning-4, 640x480, transparent) stand in for the Cooking card's seven frames, which the engineer named every card's placeholder (2026-10-22). Those frames are generated art kept in the art track (prime-game-art#272) and this repo's licence list does not cover generated art yet, so the game takes them from the art track's pack. expand_mode IGNORE_272x204 here, 352x264 in s3 and s8, stretch_mode KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED; SIZE here; the same card in s3, s5 and s8. The cards are wordless: a frame holds only its art, no caption.

children.name: Frame7
children.note: The frame that shows the finish.

children.name: Settings
children.note: One scene (#301; since the boot into the ship only the suit menu shows it): the mic, the mode, the threshold with its live meter, noise suppression and the volumes work without a session. Saved per player.

children.name: Sub
children.note: One ButtonGroup; Settings opens on Sound and voice.

children.name: Scroll
children.note: follow_focus = true, so keyboard and gamepad focus scrolls the focused row in view (the 15 keys of Controls, the volumes at large text). Spectating left the MVP (the dead wait in the dead's room), so its two keys are gone from Controls.

children.name: Mic
children.note: Without the voice add-on, Mic, TalkMode, Threshold and MicTest give way to one Label(ToyTextMutedOnLight) settings.voice_unavailable.

children.name: Device
children.note: Items: settings.mic.default, then the device names (not translated). A pick opens the device under the existing "opening" mark. A long device name is cut with an ellipsis, so the row keeps its 450 px.

children.name: Mode
children.note: Voice activation (with the threshold row), push to talk (the Talk key) or off. A dropdown like Mic: three chips would not fit the settings column at large text.

children.name: Threshold
children.note: Shown for voice activation only.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The voice-activation threshold, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Meter
children.note: The live mic level; it runs without a session (#301).

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup: RNNoise off or on.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The Master bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The voice bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The effects bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Slider
children.note: The music bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Bind
children.note: Button(ToyKeyButton), wide (min 96): its text is the bound key's label, DisplayServer.keyboard_get_label_from_physical() of the action's binding (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED); Space and the mouse buttons use key.space, key.mouse_left, key.mouse_right. A click or ui_accept starts capture.

children.name: Bind
children.note: Capturing: settings.controls.press_key on the pressed look; idle it shows the bound key's label (E). A click or ui_accept starts capture: set toggle_mode = true and set_pressed_no_signal(true), which draws ToyKeyButton's pressed StyleBox (it has no toggle partner), and restore both when capture ends. Capture runs in _input and calls get_viewport().set_input_as_handled() on every event, so nothing else sees it: the next key or mouse button binds, except the release of the click that started capture, which is ignored; Esc cancels and is consumed (the menu stays open); the arrows and ui_accept do not move or press focus while capturing.

children.name: Same
children.note: Only on rows whose key clashes with another action of the same phase (here Map and Talk on M); give_up and ready share F legally (different phases, #211).

children.name: ResetGap
children.note: A spacer: 4 + 12 + 4 = 20 px between the last row and Reset.

children.name: Reset
children.note: Restores the default bindings. Esc itself is fixed.

children.name: Mode
children.note: One ButtonGroup: DisplayServer window mode.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup. On swaps GameUi's theme to game_theme_large.tres live.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup; the default comes from DisplayServer.accessibility_should_reduce_animation(). On: the connecting spinner (s3) turns at half speed; the pre and post game fades (s6, s10) and the End fade are cuts; the button press is instant (the pressed StyleBox still shows).

children.name: Choice
children.note: One ButtonGroup; each language is named in itself (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); the language applies at once (#208). A long list later would take ToyRadio rows.

nodes.name: ConfirmDim
nodes.note: mouse_filter STOP: blocks the mouse to the menu behind while the dialog is open. Keyboard and gamepad focus search ignores what is drawn on top, so while the dialog is open set focus_behavior_recursive = FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED on Menu (Control, Godot 4.5+) and restore FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_INHERITED on close. The dialog handles ui_cancel itself (= Cancel) and calls get_viewport().set_input_as_handled(), so Esc closes only the dialog, not the menu too.

nodes.name: Confirm
nodes.note: P1. Opened by the host's Leave (esc.game.leave_confirm, Confirm esc.game.leave) or Quit (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). ui_cancel = Cancel.

children.name: ConfirmButton
children.note: Ends the session for every player; everyone returns to their own ship (Quit: quits the game).

children.name: Cancel
children.note: Focus on open; closes the dialog.
